resources.string: Move slowly to build the cloud
Every dot is a spot ARCore recognised in your room. Amber dots are what the camera sees right now; the cloud keeps everything it has seen, so walk around slowly and watch the room fill in.
Hides the points ARCore is still unsure about: fewer dots, less noise.
